reason: Momentum in strikes (Ed, 2026-10-27, his answer (a)): a creature's run-in and wind-up at the witch (a pack's tell and combo too) turn no faster than its limit and steer for where she was a moment ago; the committed lunge goes right to where the wind-up aimed (up to twice its usual length), its aim led by the lunge's own flight.

rules.*: any fight at the witch: the strikers' places, velocities and lunges differ, and so what follows

frames.*: a scene with creatures striking at her (the wave fight): they stand elsewhere
